differential.name: Acute uncomplicated cystitis
differential.rationale: Pyuria (22.8 /HPF) with dysuria in a 40‑year‑old woman is most consistent with an acute bacterial bladder infection.

differential.name: Chronic recurrent urinary tract infection secondary to an anatomic or functional abnormality
differential.rationale: History of recurrent UTIs and multiple episodes of acute cystitis suggest an underlying predisposition (e.g., incomplete bladder emptying, reflux).

differential.name: Breast cancer recurrence/metastatic disease
differential.rationale: Known malignant neoplasm of the breast; systemic symptoms or new organ involvement must be considered despite lack of specific findings.

differential.name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
differential.rationale: Overweight (BMI 29.1) and recurrent infections raise suspicion for undiagnosed diabetes, a common risk factor for UTIs.

differential.name: Stress‑related overactive bladder
differential.rationale: Documented stress and urinary symptoms could reflect functional bladder irritation in the absence of infection.
